name: What We Saw Under Eden Lake
source:
Rejected by all around them, two childhood friends weave a world and a game that belong solely to them.

[From [url=https://key000.itch.io/whatwesaw]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
两个从小一起长大的朋友，遭到周围所有人的排斥。于是，他们编织出一个只属于彼此的世界，也创造了一场只属于彼此的游戏。

［摘自[url=https://key000.itch.io/whatwesaw]Itch.io[/url]］
